title: Prometheus connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Prometheus remote-write sink's settings, read by the native protocols family (`loams_connector_protocols::prometheus`, CN2 Task 21). The source is a remote-write receiver on ingest's route and takes no settings here (R21.7). `basic.password` and `bearer` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`.

basic.description: HTTP Basic: the user name and the password's secret name.

password.description: The password. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

bearer.description: A bearer token (`key`). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.
